validator.scope: Existing exploratory Authority.check rules, including missing references, clock gaps and unknown delete targets; no frozen prototype changes
validator.actorBinding: Known browser clientIDs are registered by the test harness out of band, never inferred from untrusted submitted updates
validator.postcondition: Every accepted server candidate has pendingStructs == null and pendingDs == null

ordering.durability: localSequence allocation, nextSequence advancement and pending insertion share one IndexedDB transaction
ordering.send: Read pending by localSequence; shared Web Lock per account/diary; await server ACK and atomic local acknowledgement before the next operation
ordering.failure: Network failure, server rejection or local ACK transaction failure stops the drain without dropping later operations
ordering.identity: operationId and original Yjs update bytes remain unchanged across retries
ordering.counter: ACK and baseline changes preserve the persistent nextSequence counter

limitations: Temporary in-memory HTTP server, not production Fastify/PG/WebSocket/authentication
Existing exploratory validator is not a finished production pure-text validator
Temporary textarea, not the production ProseMirror binding
Quota fault is injected; no physical disk-full or OS power-loss verification
